title: Ternary Search Not Implemented
current_state: Linear exhaustive loop for n_sub in range(2, |V|+1)

verification: Unit test: ternary search returns same optimum as exhaustive; benchmark O(log N) scaling
acceptance_criteria: Ternary search produces identical or better n_sub* as exhaustive; runtime scales logarithmically

title: Dy-Part Does Not Beat Static Baseline

verification: Re-run benchmark with corrected code; statistical comparison

title: Approximation Ratio Exceeds 1.0

verification: Test: AR never exceeds 1.0 on any configuration
acceptance_criteria: No run produces AR > 1.0 in corrected pipeline

title: Classical Cost Beta Has Inverted Effect
current_state: gamma*(normalized_cuts^beta) with normalized_cuts<1 means higher beta = LOWER cost

resolution: Use raw num_cuts (not normalized) or use beta as 1/exponent or redesign formula

acceptance_criteria: Classical cost is monotonically increasing in beta for fixed num_cuts > 0
